name: Southwest Ridge
beta: The classic SW ridge of the highest peak in the range: the route begins with loose, blocky climbing low down, then the final two pitches offer delightful easy climbing on cracks and knobs along an exposed ridge to the summit. All routes in the Gunsight Range are short, and this one runs about 5 pitches. A 2025 ascent, which climbed the E and SW faces of Middle and the S ridge of South, confirms the line is still being climbed as a distinct objective alongside the East Face. No published numeric grade was found for this route.
